comment: Cumulative progression for the submission write-up (val split only). Rows run in this order, one engine at a time, same seeds for every row. obs_version must equal the checkpoint's sensor signature (the script refuses a mismatch and sets DOOMSDAY_OBS_VERSION per row in the child process). status 'pending' = not on disk yet; fill in checkpoint and obs_version, then set status 'ready'.
reuse_caveat: reused directories were produced before the uncommitted env/ and agent/ edits now in the working tree (git status 2026-11-26); they match the protocol, checkpoint sha256 and val map hashes exactly, but not necessarily the current observation code. Re-run with --no-reuse for a single-code-version table.

rows.note: uniform random action per head; the floor
